notes.text: Creator posts dashboard is reachable directly when the browser session is already authenticated. Entry page shows Publish Article and Project Launch actions plus post status tabs.

Publishing a 项目首发 post works from /creator/posts. Required fields observed during AgentLimb launch post: cover image, repo URL, category, topic, and tags. Text covers can be regenerated and reapplied before publishing.
[success verification] After clicking 发布, the browser returned to https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and the AgentLimb entry appeared in the list with 已发布 status.
[success verification] After clicking 发布, the page redirected to https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and the DOMPrompter 项目首发 entry appeared in the creator list with status 已发布.
[success verification] After clicking 发布, the page redirected to https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and the GlotShot 项目首发 entry appeared in the creator list with status 已发布.
[success verification] After clicking 发布, the page redirected to https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and the TrekReel 项目首发 entry appeared in the creator list with status 已发布.
[success verification] After clicking 发布, the page redirected to https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and the WitNote 项目首发 entry appeared in the creator list with status 已发布.
[success verification] Published article appeared on https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts as the top item with title 我做了个浏览器肌肉记忆工具，让 AI 别再重复摸同一个网页 and status 已发布.
[success verification] 已跳转到 https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts，内容管理列表顶部显示《我做了个点击 DOM 元素就能生成 AI 提示词的小工具》，状态为 已发布。
[success verification] 已回到 https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts，内容管理页同时包含《我做了个不强迫你把草稿交给云端的 AI 写作工具》《我做了个把 GPX 轨迹直接变成 3D 飞越视频和地图模型的小工具》《我做了个专门帮独立开发者批量做截图和图标的 macOS 工具》，均为已发布状态。

workflows.description: Reach the creator post management screen and confirm publishing actions are available.
workflows.name: Open GitWatt creator posts dashboard
steps: Confirm the page title is 创作者中心 - GitWatt
Look for 发布图文 or 项目首发 buttons to verify posting access

workflows.description: Create and publish a GitWatt first-launch project post from the creator dashboard.
workflows.name: Publish a GitWatt 项目首发 post
steps: Open https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and click 项目首发
Fill title, body, repo URL, description, category, topic, and tags
Generate a cover via 文字封面, click 使用这张封面, then click 发布
Verify the browser returns to /creator/posts and the post appears in the list with 已发布 status
